correctness.rationale: The normalized nonzero rank-one block is completely parametrized by overlap r; rotational invariance makes numerical radius half the bipartite Hermitian norm, and B=P Q* gives two exact edge Gram matrices. Entrywise Perron comparison proves the strict ordering for 0<r<1, orthogonal splitting proves the r=0 run formula, and simple-eigenvalue perturbation with the sine Perron vector proves the first-order formula. The explicit m=4 expression was checked by exact characteristic polynomial; supplementary finite matrices agree, but the all-dimensions proof is analytic.

value.rationale: A 2026 alternating-block-path theorem naturally raises whether changing adjoint orientation has a predictable quantitative impact. This exact classification treats every binary word of every finite length for rank-one blocks and gives both global extrema and position-dependent asymptotic defect penalties, resolving a structured inverse-design/comparison question beyond one toy example.
